items.title: The deposit
items.text: Habitual lease: one month, extra guarantees two months at most. Other lease types differ, and agents ask for more. We check.

items.title: Who pays the agent
items.text: The landlord pays their own agent and the lease's costs; their agent charging you is a red flag. Hiring us is optional, in writing.

items.title: The rent
items.text: No regional cap in Madrid: the asking price is the market. We say if it is out of line and read the update clause.

items.title: Contract type
items.text: A habitual-residence lease protects you in ways a 'temporada' lease does not. We check which one you are handed, and which charges land on you.

items.title: Registration
items.text: Registered at the town hall with your contract: health card and school place hang on it. We confirm it before you sign.

items.title: Income rules
items.text: Payslips, a bank guarantee, a Spanish guarantor: each landlord asks differently. New job, foreign salary, freelance — we write it so it passes.

rows.ddHtml: BOOM Madrid, the tenant-side rental desk of BOOM — operated by Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l., a registered Italian agency. You hire us; we do not act for the landlord. Paid by the tenant only.
Expats and internationals relocating to Madrid — employees, researchers, couples and families — from abroad or already in the city.
No percentage of the rent, nothing from landlords or platforms.

Spanish-format file within one working day of your papers, applications as listings appear, attended viewings with live video and written report, negotiation, contract check against Spain's tenancy law (Ley de Arrendamientos Urbanos, LAU), padrón supported.
We don't list homes, we don't represent landlords, we don't promise a date.

items.q: Isn't it the landlord who pays the agent in Spain now?
items.a: Yes. Spanish law puts the costs of the landlord's agent and of the lease on the landlord, so that agent charging you is a red flag. BOOM Madrid is a separate, optional service you hire in writing, price shown first; it works only for you and takes nothing from landlords.

items.q: What happens on the free call?
items.a: A call with Valentino, by phone or WhatsApp, at a time that suits you both. We hear your dates, budget and who is moving, say which service fits, or that none does, and which papers you are missing. Nothing is charged for the call. Full Search is refunded in full if we decline the search in the first call.

items.q: How do I avoid a rental scam in Madrid from abroad?
items.a: Never pay a deposit or first rent for a home nobody on your side has seen. With Attended Viewing (€149) a BOOM person visits it in your place, with live video and a written report. With Full Search or Application Pack we also check the contract, and that you can register on the padrón with it, before you sign.

items.q: How fast will I have an apartment?
items.a: Budget and move-in date decide it. A complete Spanish-format file and applications sent as listings appear are what shorten it. Nobody can promise a date in Madrid. Anyone who does is selling you something else.

items.q: Do I need to be in Madrid?
items.a: No. A BOOM person attends viewings in your place, with live video and a written report. The contract is checked and signed remotely. You arrive for the keys and the padrón.

items.q: What if you don't find anything?
items.a: We tell you in the first call if your budget and timeline don't fit the market; if BOOM declines the search then, the €500 Full Search fee is refunded in full. Once we take it on, the search runs until you sign or stop it, and the fee pays for the work, not for a result.
By card on this page (Stripe) when you start; the invoice comes from Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l. Flat fees, VAT included. Nothing from landlords, their agents or platforms.

items.q: What do you do with my data?
items.a: Used to answer you and run your search; if you stop at the payment, we ask once whether you have questions. No resale, no mailing lists. Ask us to delete it; invoices and payment records stay, as the law requires.

footer.tagline: Born in Rome, built for people who move countries. The same rules in Madrid: one side of the table, flat fees, everything in writing.
footer.statement: You hire us; we do not act for the landlord. BOOM Madrid acts solely as a tenant-side search agent: we do not list properties, represent landlords, or receive remuneration from landlords or their agents.
